draftContext.markdown: Both Oct 25 and Oct 26 are Accepted. The six held suggestions (three each) are in Needs Review state but are effectively blocked on Issue #386 shipping before independent action review can run safely — the 391,621/393,216 byte aggregate margin (~1,600 bytes) makes a breach on the next held-action context load a near-certainty without budget scoping. daily-logger #485 (Oct 27 independent review, DRAFT) is the confirmed next editorial step and does not depend on #386. core #572 is DRAFT/open correcting a factual conflict in the `eli` worked example; companion #573 closed 2026-10-28T01:06:59Z without merging (full-peer Claude configuration reproducibility, deliberate scope reduction, does not affect #572). Four workstation-yuri DRAFTs (#4–#7) are independent of each other and of the daily-logger train; no merge order is confirmed in the available record. morning-cockpit #60 open since 2026-10-21 with no documented merge blocker — hold reason unknown, requires owner clarification. Whether classic-space-venue #4 is a hard blocker on core #567 is not confirmed. lego-village-pipeline #44, #45, #46 are parked analysis-only or DO NOT MERGE. The 64 KiB dated-file cap is unchanged post-#483; PR #483 adds a fallback, not a limit increase. The Oct 26 one-use revision grant registered in #484 is consumed regardless of run outcome; a fresh grant is needed for any follow-up editorial action on Oct 26.
